rootCause: The fixture constructed EngineError without its required options argument. The intended ACTION_MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED became TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'cause'), so replay reported action-failed instead.
observedSideEffects: The executor treated the malformed action-failed handoff as an ordinary miss and repeated the save. The two save-request events are not evidence of an e2e uncertain-commit defect.
disposition: No retry under this card. A separately preregistered two-cell corrected experiment is in runs/e2e-uncertain-verification-2026-10-25.
